Prudential Plc Upped Belmond LTD (BEL) Position by $654,156 as Market Value Declined; Gm Advisory Group Lowered American Express Co (AXP) Holding by $1.26 Million; Stock Declined
May 15, 2018 - By wolcottdaily
Prudential Plc increased its stake in Belmond Ltd (BEL) by 33.97% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Prudential Plc bought 54,513 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.76% with the market. The hedge fund held 215,000 shares of the hotels and resorts company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.63 million, up from 160,487 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Prudential Plc who had been investing in Belmond Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.20B market cap company. The stock increased 2.64% or $0.3 during the last trading session, reaching $11.65. About 699,764 shares traded or 68.77% up from the average. Belmond Ltd. (NYSE:BEL) has declined 6.22% since May 15, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.77% the S&P500.
Gm Advisory Group Inc decreased its stake in American Express Co (AXP) by 16.03% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The hedge fund held 66,527 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.61M, down from 79,229 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Gm Advisory Group Inc who had been investing in American Express Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $87.15 billion market cap company.
